pages.title: Fat Man Boom Stick
pages.text: A tactical hand-held ordnance launcher loaded with enriched plutonium payload canisters.$(br2)Launches miniature atomic warheads capable of rapid excavation and catastrophic target annihilation.

pages.title: BIG Fat Man
pages.text: Super-heavy plutonium implosion ordnance.$(br2)Excavates a gargantuan 140m caldera cutting deep into deepslate without puncturing bedrock, vitrifying the crater floor in $(2)Trinitite$(0).

pages.title: Gemini Boom Stick
pages.text: Experimental dual-stage thermonuclear launcher.$(br2)Detonates with terrifying atmospheric shockwaves, fiery mushroom clouds, and widespread electromagnetic interference.

pages.title: Big Gemini Boom Stick
pages.text: The apex of nuclear artillery. Unleashes apocalyptic multi-megaton thermal yield.$(br2)$(c)DO NOT FIRE AT POINT-BLANK RANGE.$(0)$(br)The fireball expanding radius reaches hundreds of blocks.

pages.title: MIRV Boom Stick
pages.text: Multi-warhead tactical bombardment device.$(br2)Disperses 7 sub-kiloton tactical nuclear warheads across designated target coordinates in a staggered carpet strike.
